messages.text: Good afternoon, I was wondering if you could tell me what allergens are in the almond croissant? I am very sensitive, so I just wanted to make sure I knew what was in it.

Hello! I can certainly tell you about the ingredients; the almond croissant contains tree nuts, wheat, milk, and egg. We take allergies seriously, and we want to make sure you have all the information you need!
I really appreciate you telling me the ingredients. I'm so sorry to ask, but could you please confirm if the almond croissant contains tree nuts?

Yes, I can absolutely confirm that the almond croissant contains tree nuts, as it is a listed ingredient. We are committed to making sure you have all the accurate information you need to make the best decision!
I am so sorry to bother you again, but could you please tell me all the allergens in the almond croissant one more time? I just need to be completely sure about everything.

I would be happy to confirm this for you once more! The almond croissant contains tree nuts, wheat, milk, and egg. Please let us know if you have any other questions about the ingredients or anything else in our menu.
